summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K on June 15, 2026, announcing a temporary suspension of its $3.0 billion share buyback programme from June 12 to July 14, 2026, due to securities law requirements related to the ARC Resources Ltd. shareholder circular and meeting. This is a routine operational pause, not a termination, and does not constitute a special situation. The suspension will not affect the overall programme; deferred purchases will be part of remaining 2026 programmes subject to Board approval. No special situation classification applies.
